faults.page says: Fillip, Spring 2012 interview: "Technically, we were set up as a not-for-profit company supporting the arts, registered under the Ministry of Industry and Trade, which is subject to new laws that can change from day to night". A 2012 co-founder remark in the past tense about how Makan was set up; it does not state the legal form in force today, and the page itself says the governing law is changing.
The only cited page is a 2012 interview, not a statute, register entry or governance page of the space.
